gloss: ink pad (for rubber stamps); stamp pad

definitions.gloss: ink pad (for rubber stamps); stamp pad
definitions.explanation: A flat, ink-soaked pad used with rubber stamps to apply ink before stamping. Usually a rectangular plastic case with a fabric or felt pad inside, sold in colors such as black, red, and blue. Distinct from {朱肉|しゅにく}, the specialized vermilion pad used with formal {印鑑|いんかん} seals.

notes:
Composed of the loanword ⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧ (stamp, rubber stamp) and {台|だい} (stand, base, platform). The {台|だい} here names the pad-holder, not a separate stand.

USAGE:
Paired with rubber stamps (⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧) used for office date-stamping, craft projects, ⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧ラリー (stamp-collecting events), and school activities. Not typically used with the formal ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ seals that require ⟦{朱肉|しゅにく}→朱肉：06192_shuniku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スタンプ{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦インク→インク：00120_inku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to ink the pad (before stamping)
- スタンプ{台|だい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧: the stamp pad dries out
- ⟦{補充|ほじゅう}→補充：14037_hojuu⟧⟦インク→インク：00120_inku⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧スタンプ{台|だい}: stamp pad with refill ink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朱肉|しゅにく}→朱肉：06192_shuniku⟧: vermilion ink pad — specifically for formal seals (⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧); uses a different, oil-based ink and never called スタンプ{台|だい}
- {印|いん}パッド: ink pad — a less common katakana equivalent of スタンプ{台|だい}
- ⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧: rubber stamp — the stamp itself, applied to the pad before pressing onto paper
